Survival basics

Check current in-game rules before spending Silver

Silver is separate from regular Coins. Compare the activities, free supplies, Battle Pass and Silver Shop available in your game. Before spending, distinguish a direct purchase from a crate with random contents.

The source says Silver comes only from free activities and buys only cosmetics. Official support lists a wider range of sources and shop contents, so verify the current in-game terms instead of relying on those absolute claims.
